description: SYNTHETIC tone sequences (not speech): each symbol is a pure tone, 16 kHz mono, clips of 1.0/1.5/2.0 s (a 2 s clip has exactly 32,000 samples). Mel features with declared window/hop/padding, a tiny CTC model and greedy decoding; open the nodes for waveform, spectrogram, frame-to-token alignment and the S/D/I error alignment.
